statement.zh: 学术与教科文表述将哈图沙定为赫梯都城，并以其泥板档案为王国重建的核心证据之一（Bryce 2005；UNESCO 377）。
statement.en: Scholarship and UNESCO frame Hattusa as the Hittite capital, with its tablet archives as core evidence for reconstructing the kingdom (Bryce 2005; UNESCO 377).
